text:
maria_ml: Heads-up — onboarding CobaltFin's adapter (cfin-adapter) into the quick smokepack. Pushed one run, summary below. cc @jonathan_se @sam_research

jonathan_se: Nice. Short numbers pls?

maria_ml: Quick summary: 48/50 tests passed. 2 failures: numeric-format (commas/currency) and locale date parsing. Quality notes: EM on finance-qa down ~4.2% vs base model; avg SBERT cosine -0.03. Latency +2.1% under int4 quant with current KV layout. Artifacts + failing examples pasted. :eyes:

maria_ml: ```
# run command
./run_quickpack --model redwood-7b-cfin-stitch --quant int4 --eval finance-smoke.json --out /tmp/cfin-smoke

Results:
Passed: 48
Failed: 2

Fail cases (abbreviated):
1) prompt: "Invoice total was $1,200."
   expected: "The invoice total is $1,200."
   got: "The invoice total is 1200.0 dollars."  # comma stripped/normalized -> downstream format mismatch

2) prompt: "Payment due 01/02/2026"
   expected parse -> 2026-01-02
   got -> 2026-02-01  # locale dd/mm vs mm/dd flip
```

nora_eval: smokepack run complete — artifacts uploaded: s3://redwood-ci/artifacts/3123456701/cfin-smokepack.tar.gz. junit + diff logs in artifacts.

sam_research: int4 often exposes tokenization/alignment issues post-LoRA merge. The comma-case looks like BPE split change after merging adapter weights. Can we repro with int8 or freeze token-embeddings?

maria_ml: Agreed. Next steps I'm running two variants: (A) int8 quant of stitched model, (B) int4 but freeze token-embedding and remerge adapter via byte-aligned branch. Will also run a token-level diff to see where BPE boundaries shift. ETA ~2 hours.

lee_infra: If you want isolated capacity I can spin up a dedicated GPU node (dedicated-quant-1) so your jobs won't queue. Ping me when ready and I'll attach the dataset. :thumbsup:

jonathan_se: For customer comms, recommend temporary fallback route to `redwood-7b-base` for monetary/date-sensitive endpoints until we ship a fix. Also add the two failing prompts to their regression suite. :+1:

maria_ml: Yup — will add failing cases to customer regen tests and open a PR with the failing examples + repro script. I'll post results when both variants finish. Thanks all.
